august 16, 2019: the title track of lover arrived a week ahead of the album — a waltz she wrote alone, late, at the piano. her pitch for the sound: the last two people on a dance floor at 3 a.m., swaying. it took about six hours to record.

longlivets.com/?era=lover&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=on-this-day
why: Calendar slot 2026-08-16 15:00Z X, heartbeat:on-this-day, hook "the date" — a genuine dated Vault match, so the calendar’s symbol-thread fallback is not needed. Source: the Vault Lover item "Lover, the waltz she wrote alone" (2019-08-16, sourced Wikipedia + Rolling Stone): written solo late at the piano, released a week before the album as its third single, recorded with Jack Antonoff at Electric Lady in about six hours, and her own pitch for the sound — "just the last two people on a dance floor at 3 a.m. swaying". Second Lover post in the window (08-13 ran Cruel Summer); different pillar and subject, three days apart. | 2026-08-12 Taylor-photo standard (issue #2031, Joey directive): attached a real credited photograph of Taylor from the repo corpus (apps/web/lib/longlive/lenses.ts), rehosted under /social/library/photos/. Campaign renamed to a STORY-UNIQUE value: findPostedDuplicate treats same platform+campaign as an already-posted duplicate, so the old thematic bucket campaigns (heartbeat:*) would have false-skipped every post in a bucket after its first one landed. Visible credit line omitted from the body only because it would exceed X’s 280 weighted chars; the credit is recorded in mediaCredit.
